premise: I drained my $132,000 nursing pension to pay off my nephew’s gambling debts, and he notarized a promise that I could live in his inherited house for life; he sold the house and evicted me, but I found a recording of him admitting it was a con, sued for fraud, seized the property, and now run ‘House of Cards Boarding’ where he washes windows in a vest that says ‘Washed Out Trust’ and every lease prints his promissory‑fraud docket.
